adopted.evidence: Body doc comment already read 'generic hit/death fx for an enemy kind, from the per-enemy type tables' (page->hitfx[ene]/page->deathfx[ene] lookup -> StartFXSub) -- exact behavioral match. Carried a live REGISTER_ONLY/SCHEDULE park (attempt.parked.fn_80091ac0.20260829.v1) which is naming-orthogonal (renaming a C identifier cannot change MWCC register allocation/scheduling); the park's function anchor was repointed to the new name as part of this pass' graph repair (see the pass attempt record). fndiff spot-check after rename reproduces the IDENTICAL residual (SCHEDULE_CANDIDATE, 6 real diff lines, same opcode swap) confirming codegen-neutrality.

Takes an item* parameter, spawns a particle effect with random spin then attaches the item; callers in enemy.c and critter.c pass it as 'toss carried item' (enemy.c's own extern-decl comment). Matches an enemy dropping/tossing its loot bag with a burst-spin visual. Also carried a live REGISTER_ONLY/SCHEDULE park (attempt.parked.fn_800920e0.20260829.v1), function anchor repointed as part of this pass' graph repair.

Body attaches a streak poly (MBNewPoly) to an effect and sets its color/alpha/streak params (e->streak/streakfwdmul/streakscale) -- exact match, and the TU's own pre-existing header analysis comment already guessed '~SfxSetStreak' for this address.

Sets an effect's velocity (+ yaws the node), pyrvel (angular velocity), weight and colrad (collision radius) -- a physics-attribute setter, fitting the SfxSet<Attribute> family already present in this TU (SfxSetDamage/SfxSetHit/SfxSetMorph/SfxSetOwner/SfxSetMat/SfxSetParent).
